_about: Shared cases for the read-only Cypher check: wikipulse/qa/cypher.py (tests/qa/test_cypher_cases.py) and its JavaScript port site/cypher-check.js (tests/test_demo_graph_js.py) must both pass every one (spec 13a). Each validate case has max_rows (default 25) and one expectation: equals, startswith, endswith, ok (accepted, any text) or error (a regular expression the message must contain). A refused case with relate_writes: true really writes when it runs unchecked in Relate, the browser's engine (tests/test_demo_graph.py proves it). The cases with non-ASCII text check that both implementations read letters, digits, spaces and keywords the way Python's Unicode-aware regular expressions do; their expected text is the Python validator's output. Each bind_times case gives the query and the expected text after the time parameters are wrapped in datetime().
